messages:
Ben Harper: quick flag - after turning on sticky-routing-affinity for a subset of tenants we saw one tenant (`solstice`) emit a bunch of requests with quota project missing. billing pinged at ~10:18 :grimacing:
Rhea Singh: yup i noticed the anomaly on the new rollout card. looks like proxy now applies routing-affinity earlier which confuses the quota lookup.
Olivia Chen: we enabled the affinity to improve KV cache hits and batching. didn't anticipate changing how quota service resolves the project claim.
June: mitigation: i flipped routing.fallback.solstice -> true via console, infra applied. that restored expected quota attribution within 90s.
router-bot: feature flag change recorded: routing.fallback.solstice = ON (run id ff-9931)
Ben Harper: short-term runbook: if you see >0.5% of requests with project="-" after a routing change, enable per-tenant fallback and alert billing. keeping this scoped reduces blast radius.
Rhea Singh: long-term fix options: (A) make quota service consult the original claim prior to route-based identity, or (B) have proxy forward the original project in `x-original-project` and make quota prefer that header. leaning B to preserve affinity perf.
Olivia Chen: agree B. also let's add a lightweight metric `auth.routing.affinity_source` to the token logs (values: original, affinity) so dashboards can slice by decision source.
June: i'll add a tiny dashboard card under Rollouts -> Auth that shows "affinity decisions by tenant" and a drilldown to quota attribution mismatches. Product wants this for future rollouts.
Ben Harper: can someone add an alert rule: if tenant routed_qps / baseline_qps > 1.8 for >4m after a routing flip, page eng-platform? That will catch aggressive retry loops.
Rhea Singh: will prototype `x-original-project` passthrough in proxy today and add an integration test ensuring quota prefers the header. hoping for a small staging canary tomorrow.
Olivia Chen: also schedule a brief on-call window when we resume the rollout so SRE can watch the new metric. put tentative window in the rollout doc.
June: done — added runbook step, owners, and scheduled 30m monitoring window for the next canary. closing loop once staging canary passes.
Ben Harper: thanks all. i'll draft a short ops note to Solstice explaining the temporary fallback and that we're rolling a fix.
